status: focused private unallocated S13 checkpoint (stacked on PR132 ef65663)
qualifications: Not a native qualification: the shared contract (alpha.13 dataset missing-key semantics) normalises a missing key to "" on native and Fable; raw Chromium returns undefined. Presence is asserted through the data-* attribute.
NotExposed in measured Chromium 156 (no global interface); native exposes it as a typed model interface with capability dom:MathMLMathElement and no own members.
Host always enables MathML; generated members return RV_ERR_UNSUPPORTED when the setting is off, but the disabled-setting behaviour is unexercised.
lifetime: A retained dataset keeps its removed MathML subtree alive across host disposal and frees it after release.
